# Feature parity with Dify 1.17.1

<!-- Generated by tool/features/gen.py from tool/features/features.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Which features of Dify 1.17.1's workflow editor (and the pages around it) dify-sf's Flutter app has, which it
does not, and why. One row per feature or distinct behaviour. Statuses:

- **ported**: works as in Dify (a *deviation* notes where it is intentionally different, and why);
- **partial**: part of it is ported, the reason says what is missing;
- **not ported**: not there, the reason says why (a decision, a missing backend service, not done yet);
- **n/a**: does not apply to dify-sf (its own design replaces it, or it is a Dify Cloud / enterprise feature);
- **dify-sf only**: dify-sf's own, Dify has no counterpart.

Evidence: `spec` names Dify's own unit tests ported to Dart (`app/test/dify_spec/`, counted by
`tool/dify_spec/ledger.py`), `visual` a pixel comparison case against a real Dify (`tool/visual/cases.json`).

<a id="canvas"></a>

## Canvas & interactions

| Feature | Status | Reason / deviation | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Canvas: workflow graph on a pannable, zoomable canvas (zoom 25%-200%) | ported | Deviation: Rendered with Flutter Scene (GPU cards with live/overview tiers) instead of React Flow's DOM; geometry and numbers follow React Flow 11. | spec `workflow`, visual `canvas-basic-llm`, visual `canvas-if-else`, `app/test/dify_spec/workflow/base` |
| Canvas: dotted background | ported |  | visual `canvas-basic-llm` |
| Canvas: open at the saved viewport, else fit view | partial | The canvas always fits the graph when a document opens; the viewport is per-user view state and is not stored in the shared document (Dify saves it with the draft). A start viewport can be passed with ?view= / --view. | spec `workflow/utils`, visual `editor-basic-llm` |
| Canvas: pointer mode (wheel pans, Ctrl/Cmd+wheel and pinch zoom, middle button pans) | ported |  | `app/test/workflow_editor_test.dart` |
| Canvas: hand mode (drag pans, wheel zooms) | ported |  | spec `workflow/operator` |
| Canvas: double-click zooms in | ported |  | `app/test/workflow_editor/double_click_zoom_test.dart` |
| Canvas: click selects one node (no modifier multi-select) and highlights its edges | ported |  | spec `workflow/hooks/use-nodes-interactions.spec.ts` |
| Canvas: box selection (partial overlap) and dragging the selection | ported | Deviation: The selection lives in CanvasSelection; React Flow's _isBundled flags are not stored on nodes. | spec `workflow/hooks/use-selection-interactions.spec.ts` |
| Canvas: drag nodes (container children clamped inside the container) | ported | Deviation: A drag is a moveNode op; concurrent moves of the same node are last-writer-wins (dify-sf's conflict policy for layout). | spec `workflow/hooks/use-nodes-interactions-without-sync.spec.ts` |
| Canvas: alignment help lines with magnetic snap while dragging | ported |  | spec `workflow/help-line`, spec `workflow/hooks/use-helpline.spec.ts` |
| Canvas: arrow keys move the focused node / selection (5 px, 20 px with Shift); Enter/Space select, Escape deselects | ported |  | spec `workflow/hooks/use-node-keyboard-interactions.spec.tsx`, spec `workflow/keyboard-node-movement.browser.spec.tsx` |
| Canvas: hold Shift to dim unrelated nodes and show dashed dependency edges | not ported | Not implemented yet (the use-shortcuts dim cases are still to do in the spec ledger). | spec `workflow/hooks/use-shortcuts.spec.ts` |
| Canvas: accessibility (focusable nodes, semantics) | ported | Deviation: Semantics per on-screen card while the view rests, a summary otherwise (a GPU canvas has no DOM). |  |
| Canvas: open the editor at a node (?node_id=) | ported |  | spec `workflow/hooks/use-locate-node.spec.tsx` |
| Canvas: confirm dialogs (delete container with children, remove used variable) | ported |  | spec `workflow/index.spec.tsx` |
| Canvas: syncing-data overlay while the draft is re-fetched | n/a | dify-sf never re-fetches a draft over the canvas; the document is live (edits are collaboration ops). | spec `workflow/syncing-data-modal.spec.tsx` |
| Canvas: draft auto-save (sync the whole graph to the console API) | n/a | dify-sf has no draft sync; every edit is a journaled collaboration op confirmed by the server (see Collaboration). | spec `workflow/hooks/use-nodes-sync-draft.spec.ts`, spec `workflow/hooks/use-serial-async-callback.spec.ts`, spec `workflow/store/workflow-draft-slice.spec.ts` |
| Editor state: workflow store, persisted preferences, panel widths | ported |  | spec `workflow/store`, spec `workflow/store/workflow/debug`, spec `workflow/persistence` |
| Editor plumbing: hooks store and datasets detail store providers | partial | The datasets detail store is ported as a plain store (app/lib/src/workflow_editor/store/datasets_detail_store.dart); the React provider/context wiring has no counterpart and nothing fetches dataset details (no knowledge base service). The provider specs are still to do in the ledger. | spec `workflow/hooks-store`, spec `workflow/datasets-detail-store` |
| Loading a draft: preprocess nodes and edges (initialNodes / initialEdges) | n/a | dify-sf never builds a graph from Dify JSON in the client; documents come from the server's DSL import (CollabDSL) and arrive as collaboration snapshots. | spec `workflow/utils/workflow-init.spec.ts` |
| Read-only workflow preview canvas (templates, Explore, generator) | partial | The preview's components are ported for the parts the editor reuses; the pages that show a standalone read-only preview (template details, Explore try-app, workflow generator) do not exist in dify-sf. | spec `workflow/workflow-preview`, spec `workflow/workflow-preview/components`, spec `workflow/workflow-preview/components/nodes`, spec `workflow/workflow-preview/components/nodes/loop` |
| Go to anything: command palette node search | not ported | outside current scope (owner to decide); dify-sf has no goto-anything palette. | spec `workflow/hooks/use-workflow-search.spec.tsx` |
| Workflow generator (generate a graph from a prompt) | not ported | Needs a model provider service (no LLM runtime in dify-sf). | spec `workflow/workflow-generator` |
| Canvas: large graphs (2000 nodes at 120 fps, zoomed-out overview tier) | dify-sf only | dify-sf's own Scene renderer with culling, overview captures and a skeleton tier; Dify renders every node as DOM. | `docs/results` |
